meta.note: The repository at this commit is an unstyled create-vue scaffold; every value here is authored new from the product spec's UX, certainty and cost-display requirements.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind every panel. Daylight is the default; Night quay lets the uploaded photograph carry a darkened room.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels and cards: summary, findings list, setup rail.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Floating layers: the expanded cost ledger, menus, marker detail popovers. Pair with shadow-raised.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells that frame evidence: the photo stage and the container schematic ground.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and panel sections. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, tags), schematic outlines. Holds 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures on bg, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, captions, provenance tags, cost figures in the compact indicator. 5.9:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Chalk white in Night quay, shipping navy in Daylight. The one action colour: primary buttons, selected provider, links, the active stage. Never a status: it does not mean confident, safe or clear.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of brand controls.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected-item background (chosen provider segment, selected marker row). Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a brand or brand-hover fill. Near-black in Night quay because the chalk brand is light there; white in Daylight.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px outline offset 2px. At least 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: cert-confident-fg
tokens.usage: Confident: text and the full-disc glyph. On cert-confident-bg, surface and bg.

tokens.name: cert-confident-bg
tokens.usage: Confident chip fill.

tokens.name: cert-confident-line
tokens.usage: Confident chip border and the 3px underline beneath a confidently read ID character.

tokens.name: cert-likely-fg
tokens.usage: Likely: text and the three-quarter glyph. Same hue as confident, told apart by the glyph and the unfilled chip.

tokens.name: cert-likely-bg
tokens.usage: Likely chip fill: deliberately lighter-weight than confident.

tokens.name: cert-likely-line
tokens.usage: Likely chip border and dashed ID underline.

tokens.name: cert-uncertain-fg
tokens.usage: Uncertain / conflicted: text and the half-disc glyph. The only warm certainty colour, so it draws the eye without reading as an error.

tokens.name: cert-uncertain-bg
tokens.usage: Uncertain chip fill.

tokens.name: cert-uncertain-line
tokens.usage: Uncertain chip border and dotted ID underline.

tokens.name: cert-unknown-fg
tokens.usage: Can't tell: text and the empty-ring glyph.

tokens.name: cert-unknown-bg
tokens.usage: Can't tell chip fill.

tokens.name: cert-unknown-line
tokens.usage: Can't tell chip border.

tokens.name: cert-unseen-fg
tokens.usage: Not seen / not visible: text and the dashed-ring glyph. Never shown as clear or undamaged.

tokens.name: cert-unseen-bg
tokens.usage: Not seen chip fill, under the hatch.

tokens.name: hatch
tokens.usage: Diagonal hatch stripes for not-inspected chips and unphotographed schematic faces. Pattern, not text.

tokens.name: ink-on-sev
tokens.usage: Dark ink for numbers drawn on the light severity fills (cosmetic, minor, moderate). Not for text on the major fill.

tokens.name: sev-cosmetic
tokens.usage: Marker fill and first severity bar for apparent cosmetic damage (surface marks, no deformation). The lightest, least saturated step of the magenta severity scale. Always drawn with an ink outline.

tokens.name: sev-minor
tokens.usage: Marker fill and second severity bar for apparent minor damage. Always drawn with an ink outline.

tokens.name: sev-moderate
tokens.usage: Marker fill and third severity bar for apparent moderate damage.

tokens.name: sev-major
tokens.usage: Marker fill and fourth severity bar for apparent major damage.

tokens.name: damage-fg
tokens.usage: Text for damage codes and severity labels (DT, HO, Moderate) on surface and damage-bg.

tokens.name: damage-bg
tokens.usage: Severity badge fill.

tokens.name: hazard-fg
tokens.usage: Visible safety and DG markings only, always inside the diamond glyph: placard class, SUPER HEAVY, overwidth. Never used for uncertainty or errors.

tokens.name: hazard-bg
tokens.usage: Hazard marking badge fill.

tokens.name: error-fg
tokens.usage: System failures only (request failed, key rejected), always with the octagon glyph. Never for findings or low probabilities.

tokens.name: error-bg
tokens.usage: Error notice fill.

tokens.name: schem-side
tokens.usage: Lit long side of the container drawing (the face toward the viewer).

tokens.name: schem-side-rib
tokens.usage: Raised corrugation ribs on the long side; the alternation is what reads as steel.

tokens.name: schem-end
tokens.usage: Door end of the container drawing, a step darker than the side so the faces separate.

tokens.name: schem-end-rib
tokens.usage: Horizontal door-panel ribs on the end face.

tokens.name: schem-top
tokens.usage: Roof of the container drawing, the lightest face.

tokens.name: schem-rail
tokens.usage: Top and bottom rails and corner posts: the frame that outlines each face.

tokens.name: schem-detail
tokens.usage: Locking bars, handles, hinges and stencilled markings on the drawing.

tokens.name: schem-shadow
tokens.usage: Soft ground shadow under the container drawing.

tokens.name: schem-stroke
tokens.usage: Outer edges and corner castings of the container drawing; 3:1 or better on surface-sunken.

tokens.name: schem-grid
tokens.usage: Dashed inspection-region grid drawn over a face when a finding is selected (10 sections × upper/lower on a 40 ft side).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind labels placed on the photograph and behind the expanded ledger on phones.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Empty-state headline and the cover. One per screen.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Result headline: the one sentence a projected room reads first.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A closer photo of the top-left door markings may help.
styles.usage: Default reading text. Nothing a projected audience must read goes below this.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary explanations, finding descriptions, technical detail.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, uppercase. Mirrors how markings are printed on the doors.

styles.name: id-xl
styles.usage: The container ID hero. IBM Plex Mono for its dotted zero: O and 0 must never be confused.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Readings: weights, ISO codes, CEDEX codes, alternative IDs.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Cost ledger, token counts, latencies, provenance tags.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph-to-label gap, ID character gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, gap between tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding in lists and the cost ledger.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control padding, card inner gutter, phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between major regions (photo stage, findings, schematic).

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Empty-state breathing room, section separation on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Outer page margin on presentation displays.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Provenance tags, ID check-digit box, severity bars.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips. Steel, not pillows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Photo stage and schematic wells.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Compact cost indicator and stage dots only.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: expanded cost ledger, marker popover. Panels sit flat on borders.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of compact controls: cost indicator, icon buttons in the ledger.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, selects and the key field.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: The single main action: Inspect.

tokens.name: marker
tokens.usage: Diameter of a damage marker on the schematic; grouped markers add a count badge rather than growing.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press and focus changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Cost panel expand and collapse, chip state changes.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Marker discovery on the schematic, staggered 60ms apart. Zero under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: duration-arrive
tokens.usage: Each step of the results arrival choreography (rows rise in, ID characters settle, pins drop); steps stagger 40 to 80ms. Zero under reduced motion.
